create_adjustgamma_augmentation: create an AdjustGamma callable that applies random gamma and gain to a PIL image sample
create_sequence_augmentor: create a SequenceDispFlowAugmentor with crop_size and optional scale, flip, saturation, and gamma params
run_color_transform: run color_transform on a sequence of stereo image pairs with symmetric or asymmetric photometric augmentation
run_eraser_transform: run eraser_transform on a sequence of stereo image pairs to randomly occlude regions with mean color
run_spatial_transform: run spatial_transform on image and disparity pairs to apply random scaling, stretching, and cropping
